description_en: Queries the results of the last baseline check by using a specified baseline check policy
description_zh: 查询单个基线检查策略执行最近一次检查的结果详情
name: DescribeStrategyExecDetail

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the baseline check policy.

You can call the [DescribeStrategy](~~DescribeStrategy~~) operation to query the IDs of baseline check policies
parameters.help_zh:
基线检测策略ID。
调用[DescribeStrategy](~~DescribeStrategy~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. If you leave this parameter empty, 10 entries are returned on each page.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的基线检查结果的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条基线检查结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

EndTime.description_en: The time when the baseline check ends
EndTime.description_zh: 基线检查执行结束时间

FailCount.description_en: The number of check items that failed to pass the baseline check. This type of check item is considered risk items
FailCount.description_zh: 基线检查未通过的风险项数量

FailedEcsList.description_en: The servers on which risk items were detected
FailedEcsList.description_zh: 检测出基线风险项的服务器列表

items.description_en: The server on which risk items were detected
items.description_zh: 检测出基线风险项的服务器

IP.description_en: The IP address of the server on which the baseline check was performed
IP.description_zh: 执行基线检查的服务器实例IP地址

Reason.description_en: The failure cause for the check item
Reason.description_zh: 基线检查未通过的原因

InProcessCount.description_en: The number of tasks that are **running **based on the baseline check policy
InProcessCount.description_zh: 状态为执行中的基线检查任务的个数

Percent.description_en: The execution progress of the baseline check policy
Percent.description_zh: 基线检查策略执行的进度

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Source.description_en:
The type of the baseline check. Valid values:

Schedule: automatic check that periodically runs
Manual: intermediate check that is manually performed
Source.description_zh:
基线检查执行类型。取值：

Schedule：周期性自动检查
Manual：即时手动检查

StartTime.description_en: The time when the baseline check starts
StartTime.description_zh: 基线检查执行开始时间

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of check items that passed the baseline check
SuccessCount.description_zh: 基线检查状态为已通过的风险项数量
